Ex-Pakistani Minister Declares Himself Hafiz Saeed's 'Slave', Threatens India

Former Pakistani Interior Minister Sheikh Rasheed Ahmed has publicly stated, "I am Hafiz Saeed's slave," and praised the LeT chief. In a video circulating online, Rasheed is seen sharing a stage with individuals linked to Lashkar-e-Taiba. He also previously threatened India with a "quarter-pound atom bomb." Rasheed, a close aide of former Pakistani PM Imran Khan, served as a minister in his government. The statements highlight the alleged deep connection between power and terrorism in Pakistan.
